lines.gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਵਡਾਈਆ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਥਾਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aithai milahi vadaaeeaa daragahi paavahi thaau ||3||
lines.translation: In this world you shall be blessed with greatness, and in the Court of the Lord you shall find your place of rest. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kare karaae aap prabh sabh kichh tis hee haath ||
lines.translation: God Himself acts, and causes others to act; everything is in His Hands.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਜੀਵਾਲਦਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: maar aape jeevaaladaa a(n)tar baahar saath ||
lines.translation: He Himself bestows life and death; He is with us, within and beyond.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਸਰਬ ਘਟਾ ਕੇ ਨਾਥ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੮੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak prabh saranaagatee sarab ghataa ke naath ||4||15||85||
lines.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God, the Master of all hearts. ||4||15||85||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਣੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਆ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: saran pae prabh aapane gur hoaa kirapaal ||
lines.translation: The Guru is Merciful; we seek the Sanctuary of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਐ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਰਬ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: satagur kai upadesiai binase sarab ja(n)jaal ||
lines.translation: Through the Teachings of the True Guru, all worldly entanglements are eliminated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਲਗਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dar lagaa raam naam a(n)mrit nadar nihaal ||1||
lines.translation: The Name of the Lord is firmly implanted within my mind; through His Ambrosial Glance of Grace, I am exalted and enraptured. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: man mere satigur sevaa saar ||
lines.translation: O my mind, serve the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰੇ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kare daiaa prabh aapanee ik nimakh na manahu visaar || rahaau ||
lines.translation: God Himself grants His Grace; do not forget Him, even for an instant. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਵੀਅਹਿ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਕਟਣਹਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun govi(n)d nit gaaveeahi avagun katanahaar ||
lines.translation: Continually sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, the Destroyer of demerits.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਕਰਿ ਡਿਠੇ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin har naam na sukh hoi kar dithe bisathaar ||
lines.translation: Without the Name of the Lord, there is no peace. Having tried all sorts of ostentatious displays, I have come to see this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਉਤਰੇ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sahaje siphatee ratiaa bhavajal utare paar ||2||
lines.translation: Intuitively imbued with His Praises, one is saved, crossing over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥ ਵਰਤ ਲਖ ਸੰਜਮਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: teerath varat lakh sa(n)jamaa paaeeai saadhoo dhoor ||
lines.translation: The merits of pilgrimages, fasts and hundreds of thousands of techniques of austere self-discipline are found in the dust of the feet of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੂਕਿ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਕਿਸ ਤੇ ਜਾ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: look kamaavai kis te jaa vekhai sadaa hadoor ||
lines.translation: From whom are you trying to hide your actions? God sees all;

lines.gurmukhi: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: thaan thana(n)tar rav rahiaa prabh meraa bharapoor ||3||
lines.translation: He is Ever-present. My God is totally pervading all places and interspaces. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ ਅਮਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach paatisaahee amar sach sache sachaa thaan ||
lines.translation: True is His Empire, and True is His Command. True is His Seat of True Authority.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਧਾਰੀਅਨੁ ਸਚਿ ਸਿਰਜਿਓਨੁ ਜਹਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachee kudarat dhaareean sach sirajion jahaan ||
lines.translation: True is the Creative Power which He has created. True is the world which He has fashioned.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੮੬॥
lines.transliteration: naanak japeeai sach naam hau sadaa sadaa kurabaan ||4||16||86||
lines.translation: O Nanak, chant the True Name; I am forever and ever a sacrifice to Him. ||4||16||86||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਣਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਧਨੁ ਖਾਟਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: udam kar har jaapanaa vadabhaagee dhan khaat ||
lines.translation: Make the effort, and chant the Lord's Name. O very fortunate ones, earn this wealth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਣਾ ਮਲੁ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਕਾਟਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)tasa(n)g har simaranaa mal janam janam kee kaat ||1||
lines.translation: In the Society of the Saints, meditate in remembrance on the Lord, and wash off the filth of countless incarnations. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਜਾਪੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: man mere raam naam jap jaap ||
lines.translation: O my mind, chant and meditate on the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਫਲ ਭੁੰਚਿ ਤੂ ਸਭੁ ਚੂਕੈ ਸੋਗੁ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: man ichhe phal bhu(n)ch too sabh chookai sog sa(n)taap || rahaau ||
lines.translation: Enjoy the fruits of your mind's desires; all suffering and sorrow shall depart. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਤਨੁ ਧਾਰਿਆ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਡਿਠਾ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis kaaran tan dhaariaa so prabh dithaa naal ||
lines.translation: For His sake, you assumed this body; see God always with you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jal thal maheeal pooriaa prabh aapanee nadar nihaal ||2||
lines.translation: God is pervading the water, the land and the sky; He sees all with His Glance of Grace. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇਆ ਲਾਗੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan niramal hoiaa laagee saach pareet ||
lines.translation: The mind and body become spotlessly pure, enshrining love for the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਭਜੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਕੀਤਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: charan bhaje paarabraham ke sabh jap tap tin hee keet ||3||
lines.translation: One who dwells upon the Feet of the Supreme Lord God has truly performed all meditations and austerities. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਮਾਣਿਕਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ratan javehar maanikaa a(n)mrit har kaa naau ||
lines.translation: The Ambrosial Name of the Lord is a Gem, a Jewel, a Pearl.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਰਸ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੪॥੧੭॥੮੭॥
lines.transliteration: sookh sahaj aana(n)d ras jan naanak har gun gaau ||4||17||87||
lines.translation: The essence of intuitive peace and bliss is obtained, O servant Nanak, by singing the Glories of God. ||4||17||87||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਸਾਸਤੁ ਸਉਣੁ ਸੋਇ ਜਿਤੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: soee saasat saun soi jit japeeai har naau ||
lines.translation: That is the essence of the scriptures, and that is a good omen, by which one comes to chant the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਗੁਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਥਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan kamal gur dhan deeaa miliaa nithaave thaau ||
lines.translation: The Guru has given me the Wealth of the Lotus Feet of the Lord, and I, without shelter, have now obtained Shelter.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੋ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: saachee poo(n)jee sach sa(n)jamo aath pahar gun gaau ||
lines.translation: The True Capital, and the True Way of Life, comes by chanting His Glories, twenty-four hours a day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh bhetiaa maran na aavan jaau ||1||
lines.translation: Granting His Grace, God meets us, and we no longer die, or come or go in reincarnation. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਸਦਾ ਇਕ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man har bhaj sadaa ik ra(n)g ||
lines.translation: O my mind, vibrate and meditate forever on the Lord, with single-minded love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghat ghat a(n)tar rav rahiaa sadaa sahaaee sa(n)g ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He is contained deep within each and every heart. He is always with you, as your Helper and Support. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਾ ਕੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਿਆ ਗਣੀ ਜਾ ਸਿਮਰੀ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukhaa kee mit kiaa ganee jaa simaree govi(n)d ||
lines.translation: How can I measure the happiness of meditating on the Lord of the Universe?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸਿਆ ਉਹ ਰਸੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin chaakhiaa se tripataasiaa uh ras jaanai ji(n)d ||
lines.translation: Those who taste it are satisfied and fulfilled; their souls know this Sublime Essence.
